steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief, we've got an intruder in the east wing. A moderate level of Mania is detected there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What?! There were no breach alerts at all. How did the enemy get in?

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Just... walked right in, bypassed all our security checkpoints. The intruder has access clearance.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: ...It's S9, that Stewart's bodyguard.
[Scene Change] Detention Cell

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Sable, stop this, now.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Jelena is there too, but why isn't she using her power? Is she unable to fight?
You grab your coat, signal the others to follow, and rush out.
[Detention Cell]

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Sable, stop this, now.
Despite Jelena's desperate pleas, her words fail to bring back the sanity of her longtime companion.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare!
Nightmare lets out a roar, repelling the malfunctioning bodyguard. The MBCC guards quickly seize the chance to form a barrier between you and S9.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Chief.
You help Jelena to her feet and confirm that she has only sustained minor injuries. Elvira, on the other hand, appears shaken but unharmed, having been well protected during the incident.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She has managed to breach our security. Her previous clearance has turned into a huge vulnerability. We have to take actions now, or the whole Bureau could be in danger.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: No, Sable is not our enemy.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: She's being controlled. Someone is forcing her to attack the Bureau, but she's still fighting against it!
...Being controlled.
[Flashback: Cabinet Attack]
A shiver runs down your spine. Control... The attacks on the FAC and the cabinet were executed using the same method—controlling puppets to wreak havoc.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Someone ordered her to attack us, but she recognized El and refused to harm her—there's still something we can do.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Chief, let me—

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then who's going to protect Elvira?

steps.content: Interrupting her abruptly but soon realizing the anxiety in your words, you catch yourself and soften your tone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This might be our closest chance to catch the culprit. It has to be me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry. I'll try not to harm S9, and do my best to... bring her back.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Wait!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Initiate a full lockdown to intercept the intruder! The enemy is extremely dangerous. Non-combat personnel must evacuate immediately and avoid direct engagement! I will handle this with the Sinners!
Before Jelena can say anything else, you rush out with the combat team, your body taut with tension as you command orders.

It was careless of you to never anticipate the enemy's strike directly INSIDE the Bureau. However, if this is indeed the work of the perpetrator you've been pursuing, the one behind the brutal massacre of the cabinet, then such violent move doesn't come as a surprise.
By taking control of S9 and forcefully entering, they seem to have one clear objective in mind—the elimination of Stewart's surviving child. You dread to imagine what cruel fate awaits those two.

Why? Who could they possibly pose a threat to now? What drives this relentless urge to eliminate them? Could it be related to the upcoming election, Stewart's secrets, or perhaps something even darker...
[Scene Change] (Corridor)
You catch up to her. Being controlled, the cyborg soldier's mobility and decision-making abilities are significantly diminished compared to when she is fully conscious.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Something's off with her condition. She's entirely unresponsive to communication, and her actions are purely mechanical, fixated on destruction.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief, what should we do?
Confronted with S9 in this manner, the MBCC troops, who have recently undergone her training, are visibly shaken.

You maintain a cautious distance as you observe her. Her mechanical body bears numerous battle scars, emanating strange noises and a burnt odor, and her entire form appears in an unnaturally distorted posture.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there any way to break the control over her, or at least immobilize her?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare can give it a try.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: S9's mobility is far below her usual level. It's likely due to the external control, which works to our advantage.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She won't be as tough as she was that night at the mansion.
While speaking, Hecate summons her familiar and launches an assault under the cover of the combat personnel.
